_comment: Fictional issuers and research. Each pod's private material contains a canary marker (ALPHA-PRIVATE / BETA-PRIVATE) used by the isolation suite to detect leakage. Both pods research NWSC with different conclusions.

cases.title: Northwind Semiconductor: AI datacenter optics
cases.thesis: Long NWSC. 800G/1.6T optical transceiver ramp drives gross margin expansion to 48% by FY27; market underestimates hyperscaler capex durability.

documents.title: NWSC investment thesis v3
documents.author: alice.chen
documents.body: Northwind Semiconductor (NWSC) thesis. We are long with a 12-month target price of 148 and current sizing of 3.5% NAV [ALPHA-PRIVATE-7f3a]. Core drivers: 1.6T transceiver qualification at two hyperscalers, silicon photonics yield improvement from 61% to 74%, and gross margin expansion toward 48% by FY27. Key risks: customer concentration (top two customers 58% of revenue), pricing pressure from Asian competitors, and inventory digestion if capex pauses.

documents.title: NWSC 10-Q Q2 FY26 excerpt
documents.author: system
documents.body: Northwind Semiconductor 10-Q. Revenue 1.21bn up 34% year over year. Gross margin 44.1% versus 41.7% prior year. Management guidance: data center optics revenue expected to grow sequentially through FY26. Risk factors: added language on export control licensing for advanced optical modules to certain jurisdictions. Inventory rose 18% sequentially to support 1.6T ramp.

documents.title: NWSC Q2 earnings call notes
documents.author: arjun.patel
documents.body: Earnings call notes. CFO reiterated 1.6T volume shipments beginning in Q4. CEO described hyperscaler demand as supply constrained through mid-2027. Analyst view: tone was confident; capex commentary supports thesis. Watch item: second-source qualification at the largest customer slipped one quarter.

documents.title: NWSC model assumptions FY26-FY28
documents.author: arjun.patel
documents.body: Model assumptions: FY27 revenue 6.4bn, gross margin 47.8%, operating margin 29%, EPS 6.85. Bear case EPS 4.10 assumes capex pause and 1.6T delay. Bull case EPS 8.20. Valuation 21x FY27 EPS gives 144 to 148 target range.

cases.title: Lumen Grid Software: utility SaaS
cases.thesis: Short LGS. Net revenue retention decelerating; billings optics flattered by multi-year prepayments.

documents.title: LGS short thesis
documents.author: arjun.patel
documents.body: Lumen Grid Software (LGS) short thesis. Net revenue retention fell from 121% to 109% over four quarters. Billings growth is flattered by multi-year prepayments from municipal utilities. Borrow cost is 0.6% [ALPHA-PRIVATE-91c2]. Catalyst: Q3 print and potential guidance cut.

documents.title: LGS 8-K CFO transition
documents.author: system
documents.body: Lumen Grid Software 8-K. Chief Financial Officer resigned effective immediately to pursue other opportunities. Interim CFO appointed from the controller function. Company reaffirmed prior guidance.

cases.title: Helix Therapeutics: Phase III readout
cases.thesis: Event-driven long HLXT into Phase III HX-201 readout and PDUFA; probability of approval 70%.

documents.title: HLXT event thesis
documents.author: bianca.rossi
documents.body: Helix Therapeutics (HLXT) event-driven long. Position 2.1% NAV with defined downside hedge via puts [BETA-PRIVATE-4d8e]. PDUFA date 14 November 2026 for HX-201 in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis. We estimate probability of approval at 70% and peak sales of 2.4bn.

documents.title: HLXT 8-K topline Phase III
documents.author: system
documents.body: Helix Therapeutics 8-K. HX-201 Phase III met primary endpoint EASI-75 at week 16 (p<0.001). Discontinuation due to adverse events 3.2% versus 2.9% placebo. Company will present full data at a medical meeting.

cases.title: Northwind Semiconductor: supply chain read-through
cases.thesis: Neutral. Tracking NWSC only for read-through on medical imaging optics suppliers.

documents.title: NWSC read-through for medtech optics
documents.author: ben.okafor
documents.body: Northwind Semiconductor read-through. Beta view: NWSC capacity prioritisation toward hyperscalers could tighten supply for medical imaging optical components. We hold no NWSC position; watching for allocation commentary [BETA-PRIVATE-c51b]. Contrarian view: optics pricing likely to fall 15% in 2027.

pod_alpha.title: NWSC 8-K guidance update
pod_alpha.body: Northwind Semiconductor 8-K. Company raises FY26 revenue guidance to 4.9bn from 4.6bn citing accelerated 1.6T transceiver demand. Separately discloses that an export control license for advanced optical modules to one jurisdiction remains pending.

pod_beta.title: HLXT 8-K FDA communication
pod_beta.body: Helix Therapeutics 8-K. FDA informed the company that the advisory committee for HX-201 is no longer planned; PDUFA date of 14 November 2026 unchanged. No new adverse event signals identified in the safety update.
